name: SwipeDeck
whenToUse: A quick keep-or-skip pass over a short set: templates to try, suggested domains, onboarding interests.

whenNotToUse.text: Choosing several items the user needs to compare side by side

anatomy.description: the top card plus `depth` cards behind it, each lower and 5% smaller.
follows the pointer and tilts; past a third of its width (or a quick flick) it flies out.
buttons that do the same as a swipe left / right; labels from the locale or `skipLabel` / `keepLabel`.
what shows when every card is gone (`empty`).

do.caption: Swipe plus buttons and arrow keys: anyone can decide.

dont.caption: A drag as the only way out fails WCAG 2.5.7 and keyboard users.

a11y: The deck is one tab stop: ← skips, → keeps (mirrored in RTL).
Only the top card is in the accessibility tree; the cards behind are aria-hidden and inert.
After each decision a status message says what happened and how many cards are left.
prefers-reduced-motion: no fly-out or spring; the next card simply appears.

props.name: depth
props.description: Cards visible in the stack behind the top one (default 2).

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when every card has been swiped.

props.name: hideButtons
props.description: Hide the Skip / Keep buttons (keep the arrow keys). Only when the page offers another non-drag way to decide.

props.name: onSwipe
props.description: Called when a card leaves: `left` = skip, `right` = keep.

props.name: skipLabel
props.description: Button labels; default from the locale (Skip / Keep).
